versions.subject: Fixed condition keyword
versions.detection:
selection:
     Image: '*\setspn.exe'
selection1:
    Description: '*Query or reset the computer* SPN attribute*'
cmd:
    CommandLine: '*-q*'
condition: (selection or selection1) and cmd 
selection:
    EventID: 1
selection:
    EventID: 4688
versions.spl: EventID=4688 OR Description="*Query or reset the computer* SPN attribute*" CommandLine="*-q*"
